PathConfig

class PathConfig[source]

Bases: object

Centralized application path settings.

This class exposes directory constants and helper methods for configuration, calibration, logs, exports, and Qt resources.

Attributes:
APP_NAMEstr, class attribute

Application name used for platform-specific data directories.

APP_AUTHORstr, class attribute

Application author name used for platform-specific data directories.

CONFIG_FILENAMEstr, class attribute

Default file name for configuration files.

CALIBRATION_HARDWARE_FILENAMEstr, class attribute

Default file name for calibration hardware settings.

CALIBRATION_SETTING_FILENAMEstr, class attribute

Default file name for calibration settings.

CALIBRATION_POINT_FILENAMEstr, class attribute

Default file name for calibration point CSV data.

HELP_BASENAMEstr, class attribute

Base name of the compiled help files (ttea_<language>.qch).

PROJECT_DIRPath, class attribute

Repository root. Defined only in development mode.

BASE_DIRPath, class attribute

Base application data directory: <project>/data in development, the platform user data folder when frozen.

EXERGAME_DIRPath, class attribute

Base directory for exergame save data: <project>/src/ttea/games in development, BASE_DIR / "exergames" when frozen.

RESOURCES_ROOTPath, class attribute

Installed resources: <project>/resources in development, resources inside the PyInstaller bundle when frozen.

CONFIG_DIRPath, class attribute

Directory for configuration files.

CALIBRATION_DIRPath, class attribute

Directory for calibration files.

EXPORTS_DIRPath, class attribute

Directory for exported files.

INSTITUTIONFACILITY_DIRPath, class attribute

Directory for institution facility data.

LOG_DIRPath, class attribute

Directory for log files.

MODELS_DIRPath, class attribute

Directory containing the bundled MediaPipe models.

HELP_ROOTPath, class attribute

Directory containing the compiled help files (.qch), one per language. Read-only in installed builds.

HELP_CACHE_DIRPath, class attribute

Writable directory for the help collections and search index.

PLAYERS_DIRPath, class attribute

Directory for player files.

PROFESSIONAL_DIRPath, class attribute

Directory for professional files.

Notes

Every class attribute whose name ends in _DIR is treated as a user directory: ensure_dirs creates it and set_base_dir moves it. That includes MODELS_DIR and, in development, PROJECT_DIR; HELP_ROOT and RESOURCES_ROOT are deliberately named otherwise.

Examples

>>> PathConfig.resource('images/logo.png')
':/images/logo.png'
>>> PathConfig.help_file('en_US').name
'ttea_en_US.qch'

static resource(path='')[source]

Return a Qt resource path.

Parameters:
pathstr, optional

Resource path segment. Default is empty string.

Returns:
str

Qt resource path starting with :/.

Notes

Trailing slashes are removed from the generated resource path, so an empty path gives ":".

Examples

>>> PathConfig.resource('images/logo.png')
':/images/logo.png'
>>> PathConfig.resource()
':'

classmethod set_base_dir(path)[source]

Set a different base directory, primarily for tests.

Parameters:
pathstr | Path

New base directory path; it is resolved to an absolute path.

Notes

BASE_DIR becomes the new base and EXERGAME_DIR its exergames subfolder. Every other *_DIR attribute becomes <base>/<name>, where name is the attribute name without _DIR in lower case. These names do not always match the defaults (help_cache, institutionfacility, professional), and MODELS_DIR and PROJECT_DIR are moved too. Directories are not created here.

Examples

>>> PathConfig.set_base_dir('tests_data')
>>> PathConfig.HELP_CACHE_DIR.name
'help_cache'

classmethod find_resource_built_in(base_path, name)[source]

Find an embedded Qt resource from a base path.

Parameters:
base_pathstr

Base resource path to search in.

namestr

File name to locate.

Returns:
str

Full resource path of the first match, otherwise an empty string.

Notes

Searches base_path and its subdirectories for a file whose name matches name (a QDir name filter, so wildcards work).
